title: dukiyar da ta nutse a ƙarƙashin girman kai
intro: Ka yi tunanin tsayawa a gaban tarin dukiya mai yawa har ta kai ga ɗaukar makullan kawai zai gaji ƙungiyar mutane masu ƙarfi. A kusa da kai, muryoyi suna ƙarfafa tawali'u da tunawa, duk da haka girman kai yana ƙaruwa fiye da godiya. Me zai faru idan alheri ya zama jarrabawa kuma girman kai ya rufe sakamakon?
clues: Ni daga cikin mutanen Musa ne, amma na yi musu rashin adalci.
An ba ni taskoki masu yawa har makullan su za su ɗauki nauyin ƙungiyar mutane masu ƙarfi.
Mutanena sun shawarce ni da kada in yi farin ciki kuma in nemi Lahira ba tare da na manta da rabona na wannan duniyar ba.
Na yi iƙirarin cewa an ba ni abin da na mallaka ne kawai saboda ilimin da nake da shi.
Na yi faretin jama'ata cikin kayan ado, kuma waɗanda ke son rayuwar duniya suna fatan irin abin da nake da shi.
Ƙasa da gidana sun haɗiye ni, babu wanda zai iya taimaka mini ko kuma ni ma zan iya taimakawa kaina.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
